name: Infinite Dungeon Tales
description: A dungeon crawl that never ends the same way twice. You write the opening; the LLM writes every room after it from your choices, health and gold, and the image model paints each room as you enter.

models.note: Any instruct chat model works; 4B is fast and follows JSON schemas well.
Fast 4B image model with reference/edit support; any image model works.

params.look: a scrappy young adventurer with a dented helmet

params.title: The Mouth of the Dungeon
params.background_prompt: a crumbling stone dungeon entrance carved like a giant open mouth, moss, a single torch
params.lines:
Narrator: Legends say the dungeon rearranges itself every night.
Rook: Ten health, zero gold, and a very good feeling about this.
Narrator: Cold air breathes out of the dark.

choices: Light a torch and walk straight in

params.instructions: This is a dungeon crawler. Track `hp` and `gold` with effects (damage is negative hp, treasure is positive gold; also add 1 to `depth` on every choice). If hp would reach 0, write a bad ending. Around depth 10, offer a way out with a good ending. Keep each scene short and vivid.

params.style: dark fantasy illustration, torchlight, rich shadows, painterly

notes.text:
Infinite mode

The Choice's exits are left unconnected on purpose: when you pick one, the player asks the Dungeon Master node to write the next room, and the Room Painter paints it. Change the instructions to make it a space station, a haunted mall, or a cooking show.
